basis.bolt_diameter: Nominal shank inferred from the SNL28:004 three-quarter-inch SAE nut; no bolt diameter is separately printed in the MX1 row.
basis.bolt_under_head_length: Estimated 2.5 inch bolt stock; length is not located in SNL28. Must span the retained pad/channel/washer/nut stack with the cross hole inside a castle slot.
basis.bolt_head_af: Estimated head geometry, matching the existing nominal 3/4 inch hardware convention; not a printed head dimension.
basis.bolt_head_height: Estimated head geometry, not a printed dimension.
basis.receiver_radial_clearance: Geometric allowance for nominal, unmodeled threads; not a historical manufacturing tolerance.
basis.head_spotface_radius: Estimated local flat head seat clearing the central outside casting web. The source does not dimension a spotface.
basis.inner_row_offsets: Inferred distribution: two bolts per pad on each inside bracket, four per bracket. SNL gives total20, not this pattern.
basis.outer_row_offsets: Inferred distribution: three bolts per wider outside pad, six per bracket. Together with inside brackets gives the printed total20. Photograph does not uniquely resolve the hidden pattern.
basis.flange_height_station: Center of the inherited 50 mm channel flange; matching the current MX13 bevel washer seat.
basis.cotter_length: SNL28:005 printed 1.5 inch split pin; do not reuse the shorter MX5 pin.

casting_revision.method: Move the inferred inside pad rear/front planes together onto the existing outside bracket/channel mounting plane, retain pad stock and rebuild the joining web, then replay all later detailed casting features.
casting_revision.qualification: Explicit mechanical-interface hypothesis exceeding the original single-edge pick allowance. It is not a source-dimension correction or a claim that the drawing proves coplanar mounting faces. No M386/M387 identity is assigned to this gap.

variation.purpose: Move both transverse pad patterns outward by 4 mm and extend estimated bolt stock by 3.175 mm while retaining source quantity and castle-pin interface. Rebuild all receiver holes and installed joints.
